sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION The Note is convertible, subject to certain conditions, at a variable
price equal to 95% of the lower of (a) the daily volume-weighted average price (“ VWAP ”) of our common stock for the
trading day immediately preceding the date of measurement; and (b) the average daily VWAP for the common shares for the five (5) trading
days immediately preceding the date of measurement. Because the Conversion Shares issuable upon conversion of the Note may be issued at
prices significantly below the book value or trading price of our common stock at the time of issuance, and because the number of shares
